defect_summary: Pull request #73 (release/v0.7.0 to main) opened before origin/main was contained on the release line.
unsuitable_process: The planner blocks CREATE_PR when main_context is not contained, but pr-offer-gate.py (the skill's only allowed gh pr create) does not call main_context. ADR 0049 treats a squash on main as not_contained.
climb_steps: #73 opened while CONFLICTING after the #71 squash.
ADR 0049 requires contained before a ship merge path.
